SELECT Count(*)
FROM   (SELECT a.customer_id,
               b.customer_id,
               a.hcp_city_raw,
               b.hcp_city,
               a.total_calls_raw,
               b.total_calls,
               a.total_vaes_raw,
               b.total_vaes
        FROM   (SELECT DISTINCT tc.customer_id,
                                Trim(rp.hcp_city) AS hcp_city_raw,
                                Cast(Nvl(total_calls, 0) AS INT) AS Total_Calls_raw,
                                Cast(Nvl(total_vaes, 0) AS INT)  AS
                                Total_VAEs_raw
                FROM   temp1_customer tc
                       LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id,
                                         Sum(CASE
                                               WHEN channel_id = 'CALL'
                                                    AND call_position = 'P1'
                                             THEN
                                               actual_count
                                             END) AS total_calls,
                                         Sum(CASE
                                               WHEN channel_id = 'VAE'
                                                    AND call_position = 'P1'
                                             THEN
                                               actual_count
                                             END) AS total_vaes
                                  FROM  PO_PRE_PROCESSING_OUTPUT
                                  GROUP  BY customer_id) po
                              ON tc.customer_id = po.customer_id
                       LEFT JOIN src RP
                              ON tc.customer_id = rp.customer_id) a
               LEFT JOIN customer b
                      ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id) f
WHERE  trim(hcp_city_raw) != hcp_city
        OR total_calls_raw != total_calls
        OR total_vaes_raw != total_vaes;
